essence: After the prior step, one should worship Yajnavalkya and Bhargava in the sixteen-petaled enclosure.
One should worship Samkhya, Patanjala, the arts, and the six Veda-limbs in sequence.
One should worship the smritis and the weapons of the lords of the directions at the front of the ground enclosure.
After performing oblations and completing the rite with feeding brahmins, the mantra becomes accomplished.
Only this one is born accomplished, and no other brahmin ever is.
